items.title: Reducing Memory Overhead in Valkey 9.1
items.summary: The Valkey project says Valkey 9.1 trims per-key memory overhead for strings and sorted sets, so a cache may achieve a higher hit rate.
evidence: Valkey 9.1 introduces three optimizations that reduce the per-key memory overhead
reduce the memory required to store strings and sorted sets
your cache may achieve a higher hit rate without requiring any changes

items.title: Manage caches with precision using Amazon CloudFront Invalidation by Cache Tag
items.summary: Amazon Web Services describes invalidating CloudFront objects by cache tag so related content can be purged together, and reports that invalidations take effect in under 5 seconds at P95.
evidence: Amazon CloudFront is launching Invalidation by Cache Tag
you can invalidate groups of related cached objects using a single invalidation request
invalidations take effect in under 5 seconds at P95
